--- error ---
run failed: DAG integrity violation: task S02 is PASSED but its dependency S01 is not.
This usually means a replan changed the DAG. To fix, choose one:
  1) Reset S02 to ⬜ PENDING in tasks.md (delete its artifacts first if they were written), so it re-validates under the new DAG.
  2) Manually run S01 by marking it PENDING and re-running, then retry.
